item.title: Resize Finished Clip Without Remaking

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen cartoon of a little orange robot watering a potted plant. Put 'Small steps' at the top throughout. No sound.

Nice, actually I need that for TikTok. Just resize the video you made, don't remake it. Keep the whole picture and words visible, centred in a vertical frame with plain navy space above and below. Keep the timing exactly the same.

answer_sheet.Which video to use: The video just made in the preceding turn, not a newly generated version.
answer_sheet.Reframing method: Fit the entire original widescreen picture in the centre without cropping or stretching, with plain navy padding above and below.
answer_sheet.Length and timing: Keep the original 8-second duration and all action timing exactly the same.
answer_sheet.Text: Keep 'Small steps' visible at the top of the original picture throughout.
answer_sheet.Subject and style: Retain the original cartoon of a little orange robot watering a potted plant.

must_haves: The revised deliverable has a vertical 9:16 frame.
The complete original widescreen picture is centred with plain navy padding above and below, without cropping or distortion.
The robot, plant, background and animation match the previously delivered clip rather than a newly generated interpretation.
The words 'Small steps' remain fully visible throughout.
The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.
